page.title: Government fine defense and recovery
page.summary: Analysis and defense against fines, sanctions, and improper charges issued by authorities.
page.intro: A fine should not be handled improvisationally. We review authority, reasoning, evidence, deadlines, and defense or recovery opportunities.

cards.title: Legality review
cards.description: We detect issues in authority, legal basis, reasoning, or procedure.

cards.title: Defense strategy
cards.description: We choose the route based on evidence, cost, and operational consequences.

cards.title: Potential recovery
cards.description: When there is an improper payment, we evaluate refund or offset with documentary support.

page.trustTitle: Before acting, the matter is organized.
page.trustDescription: Each service starts with context, scope, and a responsible route. Sensitive information is requested only when the channel and objective are clear.

trustItems.title: Clear method
trustItems.description: Facts, documents, deadlines, and risks are separated before recommending an action.

trustItems.title: Information care
trustItems.description: The first contact stays general until scope and channel are confirmed.

trustItems.title: Multilingual attention
trustItems.description: The first approach can be prepared in Spanish, English, or Chinese depending on the matter.

page.moduleTitle: Separate legitimate charges from defendable acts.
page.moduleDescription: A fine is reviewed by authority, reasoning, procedure, evidence, and operational effects.

moduleItems.title: Act review
moduleItems.description: We identify who issued the fine, under what basis, and what it requires.

moduleItems.title: Economic impact
moduleItems.description: The cost of paying, defending, or recovering is compared before moving forward.

moduleItems.title: Recovery route
moduleItems.description: If there was an improper payment, support is prepared for refund or offset.

page.ctaTitle: Share the context before deciding the route.
page.ctaDescription: Astra Legal can review general context and identify a responsible next step. Do not send sensitive documents until the channel and scope are confirmed.
